config.multiplier.name: Charge speed
config.multiplier.tooltip: How much faster a hoe or watering can charges up while you hold the button. 4.0 is four times as fast as normal; 1.0 is the normal speed.
config.instant.name: Instant charge
config.instant.tooltip: The tool jumps straight to full charge the moment you hold the button. When this is on, the charge speed setting is ignored.
